{{Article header|deck=A field reference for Fumerola Carbosis, including value, sampling distance, environmental profiles and known visual variants.}}

{{Exobiology species infobox}}

'''Fumerola Carbosis''' is a tube-shaped Fumerola species associated with carbon- and methane-based volcanism. An inner organism protrudes from the opening at the top, increasing the surface available for heat absorption.<ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], snapshot retrieved 28 September 2026.</ref>

== Identification ==

Look for thin upright tubes around appropriate volcanic terrain. The organism is biological Fumerola, not the geological [[Fumarole]] feature family.
